messages.subject: CK Power | Clean power, regional projects and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear CK Power Leadership Team,

CK Power's regional power portfolio and focus on sustainable infrastructure align closely with my experience across energy transition, government relations and complex stakeholder execution.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, along with carbon-data readiness and multi-agency regulatory coordination. I also manage community priorities and formal operating commitments across technical and corporate functions.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a CK Power-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
